M0.title: arena parity
M0.note: PASS: g16r4 arm bit-exact (0/450 row diffs); g24r4 arm aggregate-exact (205/232, 38.5% opt) with 34/232 float-drift rows vs the origin-machine reference (thread-count flip demonstrated); forward arm (spr.fwd) 0/450 row diffs vs comparison_forward.json. FINDINGS §2.
M0.plain_note: The test harness reproduces the recorded results, so every later comparison stands on checked ground.

M1.title: size-free rebuild matches supervised
M1.note: PASS at both sizes for all four size-free pairs; mixed pair beats the per-size supervised pair at g24r4 (215/232, regret 2.43, 54.4% opt vs 205/232, 4.20, 38.5%) and ties at g16r4; zero-shot cross-size transfer both directions; collapsed cold value = warm value (policy dominates the arena A*). FINDINGS §7.
M1.plain_note: One size-free network pair replaced the per-size planners and beat the best of them at 24x24 with far less search.

M2.title: search beats greed at inference
M2.note: PASS both families, both sizes. Size-free MCTS: g16r4 401/450, 7.76 mv, regret 1.54, 57.4% opt; g24r4 215/232, 9.35, 1.78, 57.2% -- at the base-language ceiling (§3). FINDINGS §5, §8.
M2.plain_note: With the same networks, tree search beat the one-shot chooser on every exam.

M3.title: one self-play iteration helps
M3.note: B2 loop g24r4: iteration 3 vs 0 frontier 158 vs 133 (p=5e-6), graded at B2 ceiling with regret 1.87/1.50 and -32% expansions; base loop flat (saturated). FINDINGS §10-§15.
M3.plain_note: One round of self-play produced a real, statistically checked improvement in the extended vocabulary.

M4.title: the loop climbs
M4.status: pass (5 iterations; climb saturates after iteration 3)
M4.note: FINDINGS §19: frontier A* 133->144->139->158->153->153 (it5 vs it0 p=8e-4), graded A* 223->227 at 53->30 exp; MCTS graded 228 flat, regret 1.55->1.46->1.55; frontier MCTS 171->178->174 flat; beats frozen supervised B2 rows p<1e-4; moves on shared solves never improve beyond noise (search distilled into nets, not lower moves)
M4.plain_note: Five self-play rounds beat the solver-taught baseline by a wide margin. The gains were solve rate and search speed, not shorter solutions.

M5.title: scale + zero-shot transfer
M5.status: done: curriculum loop (§20/§22), far-size audits (§17), variants lab waves 1-5 (§23/§25/§26); planner-of-record = v14 training + hybrid d2/d3 search (flagship: graded 231/232 rg 0.944/0.861, frontier 177/218, unseen 188/200 +1.47 vs perfect; transfers zero-shot to 32/8r with paired 17/0, 23/0)
M5.plain_note: Training on all three board types at once ended the stall, and the networks transfer to board sizes they never saw.

M6.title: beyond the oracle (80x80+, certification only)
M6.status: started: M6 lead agent in Phase 0 feasibility (M6_DESIGN.md to come); budget <=20 nh
M6.plain_note: In progress: self-play on boards too big for any exact solver. Physics replay is the only ground truth there.

ceiling.title: candidate-generator / plan-language ceiling on the moves metric
ceiling.note: base language moves-ceiling: g16r4 90.7% solve, best-plan regret +1.42 (61.8% reach d*); g24r4 93.1%, +1.72 (57.4%); B2 language +0.90/+1.17. Forward planner regret 0.07 -> subgoal space cannot approach it; subgoal loop's target = the 2.5-move gap supervised->ceiling. FINDINGS §3.
ceiling.plain_note: Exhaustive probes measured the best score any sub-goal planner could ever reach.

forward_mcts.title: primitive-move MCTS arm at g16r4 (owner: both action spaces)
forward_mcts.status: F-M0 pass; F-M2 done (MCTS ≈ A* only at 17x expansions)
forward_mcts.note: spr/fwd: PUCT over slides on MoveNet Guide; F-M0 parity vs comparison_forward.json (candidate_scored 450/450), F-M2 arms (astar/greedy/mcts) on bench450, fwd_iter loop ready.
forward_mcts.plain_note: The move-by-move planner line: near-perfect moves when it solves, at a high search cost.

transfer.title: headroom probe: mixed size-free pair zero-shot on g24r4 frontier, g32r4, g24r8 (+ceilings)
transfer.note: mixed size-free pair zero-shot: g32r4 156/175 (=ceiling) regret 1.84/1.63 vs supervised 147, 2.37; g24r8 147/161 vs 144; frontier +9/+14/+17 solves. FINDINGS §9.
transfer.plain_note: The networks were tested unchanged on board sizes and robot counts they never trained on.

forward_loop_g24r4.title: primitive-move arm self-play loop at g24r4 (F-M3/F-M4)
forward_loop_g24r4.note: 2 iterations at 24x24 (jobs 4703446/4703467): optimality 94.1->96.3% (moves p=0.04 vs iteration 1), solve rate at supervised parity (219 vs 220)
forward_loop_g24r4.plain_note: Self-play for the move-by-move planner, two rounds: solutions got closer to perfect (94.1% to 96.3% optimal); the number solved stayed level.

variants_lab.title: self-play design-variants lab (owner 2026-08-20: many approaches, matched comparisons, unseen-board generalization exam)
variants_lab.status: COMPLETE, standing down to maintenance (waves 1-5; final ledger pending two control legs): adopted v09/v04/v14/v07-d2; killed v01/v12/v15/v16; three lessons in variants/DESIGN.md §7; ~28/50 nh
variants_lab.note: no exact labels in the loop (certification only; exact = diagnostic/control arms); unseen exam = fresh lean boards ids>=20000 with backward+forward supervised baselines benched on the same boards
variants_lab.plain_note: A controlled lab tested 11 ideas one at a time. Four were adopted. The rest were closed with reasons recorded.
